title: PAPT, CAPP & Native Asset Registration Bridge
objective: Implement only the bounded PAPT, CAPP & Native Asset Registration Bridge: register native/first-party resources and CAPP/PAPT outputs into ARI with source entity, tool/renderer, version, rights/use capabilities and derivative lineage while preserving each owner domain.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: CONTROL-PLANE-REGRESSION: legacy ROADMAP_INDEX.current selector remained in the atomic-selection test after MV-CONT-009 normalization
diagnostic_hypotheses: The legacy regression still treated ROADMAP_INDEX.current as active execution authority after MV-CONT-009 replaced that role with CURRENT_WORK_POINTER plus ROADMAP_COMPILED_PROJECTION.
The deterministic compiled roadmap projection also needed regeneration from the started CURRENT_WORK_POINTER.

changed_since_previous: ROADMAP_COMPILED_PROJECTION.current_selection regenerated from the started ARI-18 pointer
current control-plane regression aligned to authority registry, runtime registry and compiled roadmap projection instead of legacy ROADMAP_INDEX.current

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-11
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-18 registers first-party/native and generated CAPP/PAPT outputs as immutable ARI resource records with source owner/version, production metadata, explicit rights/use evidence, and supported derivative/version lineage.
CAPP/PAPT/native source semantics remain owner-domain truth; ARI does not create a second source-domain ledger or mutate source identities.
Reference use must be explicitly allowed; rights are never inferred from source class, tool, renderer, recipe or provider identity.
ARI-03 one-parent derivative lineage is reused; unsupported multi-parent lineage fails closed rather than expanding the lineage model.
ARI-19 picker/query API and later ARI work remain unimplemented by this tranche.
active_substep: completed_verified; application PR #462 merged after exact-head cross-platform Validation Core
next_action: ARI-18 is closed. ARI-19 is the strict successor and must remain selected_not_started until its own governed-start transition precedes application branch creation.
